name: EGD Finance claimAllReward prices rewards from live pair balances
summary: EGD_Finance.claimAllReward converts each stake's USDT reward quota into EGD at getEGDPrice(), the EGD/USDT pair's live USDT balance divided by its EGD balance. Inside a flash swap that emptied the pair's USDT, the attacker claimed the reward of an 18-block-old 100 USDT stake, received 99% of the contract's EGD and sold it.
notes: The reset is the ProxyAdmin upgrade to the exploited implementation; the second Upgraded event to the same implementation at block 19968082 changed neither code nor state.

EGD is valued at what the attacker's same-transaction sale realised, the pair's net USDT outflow with USDT at par (rule 15); the 10% transfer-tax share realised nothing. The attacker's 100 USDT stake is setup, not netted.
All other claimAllReward calls came directly from EOAs at unmanipulated prices, so there is no earlier exploit and no campaign.
